known_issues: Named faculty, clinical prediction, model-risk, biostatistics, clinical-informatics, clinician, accessibility, privacy, responsible-AI, and independent-instructor reviews remain pending before alpha.
A live learner defense remains required; the included defense is a reference answer key.

All model data are synthetic and support no real clinical performance claim.
The test partition has four outcomes and the locked threshold yields 23 false positives and 2 false negatives.
Calibration and subgroup evidence are sparse and support no stability or fairness conclusion.
No external, prospective, safety, workflow, monitoring, or deployment validation has occurred.
